_note: Hidden items (owner, 2026-10-16: 'some reason for exploration'). Placed in rooms by 'item' markers (tools/level/*.py). Picking one up sets the flag 'item:<id>'. Effects: maxHealth, flasks, weapon (gives that weapon, src/data/weapons.json). A 'set' gives its bonus when every item of the set is found. Descriptions are original.

sword.name: The Atoner's Blade
sword.text: A plain, heavy blade left at the end of the crypt, wrapped in an old stole. It is lighter in his hand than it should be.

spear.name: The Byzantine Spear
spear.text: A Janissary's spear, left on the parade ground by a captain who looked the other way. Longer than the sword, and slower. Two long thrusts; strike first from out of reach.

heart1.name: Sacred Heart
heart1.text: A silver heart pierced with thorns. It beats faintly. More life.

heart5.name: Sacred Heart
heart5.text: Found behind iron bars in a spice merchant's cellar, wrapped in a prayer from Rome. More life.

chalice3.name: Imperial Chalice
chalice3.text: Blue glass and gold, left on a rooftop shrine for no god Abel knows. One more flask of holy water.

heart6.name: Sacred Heart
heart6.text: Set high on a cistern ledge by someone who still remembered Rome. More life.

teapot.name: Porcelain Teapot
teapot.text: Blue and white, chipped at the spout, kept behind bars like a crown jewel. An old outcast's only treasure, and now Abel's. More life.

chalice4.name: Servants' Chalice
chalice4.text: Plain tin, hidden on a landing of the servants' stair by someone who prayed between errands. One more flask of holy water.

teacup.name: Porcelain Cup
teacup.text: Blue and white, from the same service as the outcasts' teapot. Someone carried it up to the warehouse rafters and never came back for it.

saucer.name: Porcelain Saucer
saucer.text: Left on a ledge in the hall of mirrors, where a hundred reflections could watch a servant drink in secret.

sugarbowl.name: Porcelain Sugar Bowl
sugarbowl.text: At the far end of the glasshouse ribs, among the blossom. Still half full. Abel takes two lumps, for courage.

chalice1.name: Silver Chalice
chalice1.text: A chapel's chalice, hidden from the Count's men. One more flask of holy water.

porcelain.name: A Byzantine Tea Service
porcelain.text: Teapot, cup, saucer and sugar bowl: the whole blue-and-white service. Abel takes tea in an empire of vampires, and has never felt more at home: one more flask, and more life.

tea.name: A Proper Pot of Tea
tea.text: All six tins. Abel brews a proper pot, and feels like himself again: one more flask, and harder blows.
